 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
 
 
Circular 
Department: FUTURES & OPTIONS SEGMENT 
Download Ref No: NSE/FAOP/76865  Date: October 12, 2026 
Circular Ref. No: 139/2026  
 
 
All Members, 
 
Exclusion of Futures and Options contract on POLYCAB 
This is in continuation to Exchange circular no. NSE/SURV/76858 dated October 12, 2026 regarding Derivatives 
contracts in Polycab India Limited (POLYCAB). Members are requested to note that the following security shall 
be excluded from Equity Derivatives segment.  
Sr. No Symbol   Security Name 
01 POLYCAB POLYCAB INDIA LIMITED 
 
Accordingly, the contracts for new expiry months in the above security will not be issued on expiry of existing 
contract months. 
However, the existing unexpired contracts of expiry months  October 2026, November 2026 and December 
2026 would continue to be available for trading till their respective expiry  date and new strikes would also be 
introduced in the existing contract months. 
 
Accordingly, no contracts shall be available for trading in the above mentioned securit y with effect from 
December 30, 2026. 
 
 
For and on behalf of 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
 
Khushal Shah 
Associate Vice President
